title: MyPersonas Stripe sandbox and signed-in privacy release matrix

cases.title: Separate staging and Stripe test-mode boundary
actions: Verify the Supabase ref is not production, Stripe objects report livemode=false, and both billing gates begin false.
expected: No test Customer, Price, Session, subscription, event, or entitlement is stored in production.

cases.title: Exact Product and three recurring Prices
actions: Retrieve each configured Price and its Product through the Stripe test API.
expected: Weekly is USD 2000/week, monthly is USD 5000/month, yearly is USD 33300/year; all are active, recurring, test mode, and share the configured Product.

cases.title: Exact webhook endpoint and event allowlist
actions: Retrieve the test webhook endpoint configuration.
expected: The enabled event set exactly matches the application allowlist and the endpoint targets staging stripe-webhook.

cases.title: Customer Portal cancellation boundary
actions: Open the test Customer Portal and inspect the available operations.
expected: Payment-method update and cancel-at-period-end are available; unreviewed plan switching, coupons, prorations, and automatic refunds are unavailable.

cases.title: Test/live crossover fails closed
actions: In an isolated disposable staging run, substitute a live-mode object or a mismatched Product/Price scalar one at a time.
expected: Checkout and webhook processing fail closed without entitlement, a live charge, or leaked provider detail.
evidence: redacted error and unchanged entitlement readback

cases.title: Weekly trial, conversion, and renewal
actions: Complete weekly Checkout with a required test payment method, advance first to the trial-will-end boundary, then trial end, then one renewal.
expected: Exactly seven trial days, then USD 20.00 conversion and USD 20.00 renewal; entitlement follows canonical paid invoices.

cases.title: Monthly trial, conversion, and renewal
actions: Complete monthly Checkout and advance its test clock first to the trial-will-end boundary, then trial end, then one renewal.
expected: Exactly seven trial days, then USD 50.00 conversion and USD 50.00 monthly renewal.

cases.title: Yearly trial, conversion, and renewal
actions: Complete yearly Checkout and advance its test clock first to the trial-will-end boundary, then trial end, then one renewal.
expected: Exactly seven trial days, then USD 333.00 conversion and USD 333.00 yearly renewal.

cases.title: Payment method is required during trial Checkout
actions: Attempt to finish a trial Checkout without entering a test payment method.
expected: Checkout cannot complete and no entitlement is granted.

cases.title: Cancellation during trial
actions: Schedule cancellation during the trial and advance beyond the cancellation boundary.
expected: No paid renewal occurs and paid capabilities suspend at the effective cancellation boundary.

cases.title: Cancellation at paid-period end
actions: Cancel an active paid subscription in the portal and advance to just before and just after period end.
expected: Access remains through the paid period, no renewal occurs, and suspension begins only at period end.

cases.title: 3DS or SCA action and recovery
actions: Use Stripe's test payment method that requires authentication, interrupt once, then complete authentication.
expected: Incomplete authentication never grants access; successful recovery grants only after canonical webhook processing.

cases.title: Payment failure, immediate past-due suspension, and recovery
actions: Cause a renewal payment failure, observe state, replace the test payment method, and pay the open invoice.
expected: past_due suspends paid capabilities immediately; a canonical invoice.paid restores eligible access without stale work bursting.

cases.title: Incomplete payment expiration
actions: Leave the initial payment incomplete and advance through Stripe expiration.
expected: incomplete and incomplete_expired never grant access; retry starts only through the approved Checkout path.

cases.title: Paused, unpaid, and resumed states
actions: Exercise paused and unpaid test states, then a canonical resume and paid invoice.
expected: Paused and unpaid remain suspended; resumption restores only after the required canonical paid evidence.

cases.title: Duplicate event is idempotent
actions: Redeliver the exact same supported test event.
expected: The second delivery is terminally idempotent with no duplicate transition, invoice, trial claim, or alert.

cases.title: Modified payload with reused event ID is quarantined
actions: Run the rollback-only SQL/runtime digest-conflict fixture with one synthetic event ID and two different payload digests.
expected: Digest conflict reaches review_required and never mutates entitlement.

cases.title: Old and out-of-order subscription events
actions: Deliver a newer canonical snapshot, followed by an older update and older deletion.
expected: Older events are recorded but cannot roll the accepted subscription snapshot backward.

cases.title: Invalid signature, stale timestamp, and unsupported event
actions: Exercise an invalid signature, a signature beyond tolerance, and a valid unsupported event.
expected: Invalid or stale signatures are rejected before JSON use; unsupported valid events are harmless and do not mutate entitlement.

cases.title: Retry exhaustion creates durable operator review
actions: Use the rollback-only SQL fault fixture to exhaust the bounded processing retries and inspect its durable disposition.
expected: The event becomes review_required with a critical alert and no infinite provider retry or silent entitlement repair.

cases.title: Canonically linked full refund
actions: Issue an approved full refund in Stripe test mode and wait for canonical event processing.
expected: An exact-account financial hold suspends access and remains until AAL2 administrator reconciliation; no automatic provider action occurs.

cases.title: Canonically linked partial refund
actions: Issue an approved partial refund in Stripe test mode.
expected: The exact account enters financial review and the bounded UI exposes no provider identifier or raw payload.

cases.title: Refund updated and failed events
actions: Exercise refund.updated and refund.failed in isolated Stripe fixtures.
expected: Each canonical event is durably reviewable; neither clears an existing hold silently.

cases.title: Dispute creation, update, and closure
actions: Exercise canonical dispute created, updated, and closed events in test mode.
expected: Creation holds access; updates and closure never clear the hold silently; the exact internal hold requires explicit reconciliation.

cases.title: Unknown Customer financial event
actions: Deliver a canonical test financial event whose Customer has no local binding.
expected: No account is guessed and no owner entitlement changes; the event remains bounded for operator review.

cases.title: Customer-binding fallback hold
actions: In isolated fixtures, make canonical Charge and Customer ownership provable while Invoice/Subscription linkage is unavailable.
expected: The bound account receives a conservative hold with nullable invoice/subscription evidence and no cross-account effect.

cases.title: AAL2 financial-hold reconciliation
actions: Try reconciliation as an ordinary user, technician, AAL1 global admin, then AAL2 global admin using the internal hold UUID and a substantive reason.
expected: Only AAL2 global admin succeeds; the audit records the exact hold and reason without claiming to issue a refund or close a dispute.

cases.title: Completed but initially unreconciled Checkout
actions: Run the lost-response contract fixture after provider completion, then apply the canonical Checkout event in the rollback-only runtime harness.
expected: The exact reservation is recovered idempotently and only the verified canonical subscription can grant access.

cases.title: Duplicate renewable subscription remediation boundary
actions: Create an externally duplicated test subscription for the same bound Customer and run the provider-remediation worker.
expected: The duplicate is quarantined, automatic cancellation targets only the proven duplicate under idempotency, the canonical subscription remains, and a durable audit records the outcome.

cases.title: Expired Session and Checkout idempotency
actions: Let a Session expire, retry twice, and redeliver its expired event.
expected: The old reservation closes once, no duplicate Customer or renewable subscription is created, and a new attempt receives one new Session.

cases.title: Consumed-trial rebinding is refused
actions: Attempt to bind an already-consumed trial claim to a different subscription.
expected: The attempt fails closed and neither subscription receives a fresh trial entitlement.

cases.title: Concurrent Checkout attempts
actions: Start Checkout concurrently from isolated sessions for the same account.
expected: At most one active reservation, Customer, and Checkout Session exists; the other caller receives a bounded retry response.

cases.title: Checkout versus account deletion
actions: Run the rollback-only concurrency harness for Checkout preparation, Customer binding, and full account deletion.
expected: The common account lock produces one safe outcome; no orphaned renewable Customer/subscription or deleted-but-entitled account remains.

cases.title: Checkout kill switch during provider_pending and attach
actions: In the rollback-only and mocked-provider fixtures, disable Checkout first while provider_pending and then immediately before Session attach.
expected: Both boundaries fail closed; an unknown provider outcome remains quarantined until canonical reconciliation.

cases.title: Late completion after local expiration
actions: Deliver a canonical completed event after the local reservation was believed expired.
expected: Only canonical provider state decides completion; the exact late event attaches safely or opens explicit review, never a guessed duplicate.

cases.title: Same account cannot receive a second trial
actions: Cancel or expire the first trial, then start another plan from the same account.
expected: Checkout truthfully shows an immediate first charge and does not include another trial.

cases.title: Changed email on same account cannot reset trial
actions: After consuming a trial, change and verify the account email, then request Checkout.
expected: The account UUID tombstone prevents a second trial; no raw email is stored in the billing ledger.

cases.title: Deleted and recreated account with same verified email
actions: Use the approved disposable-account flow to consume a trial, complete deletion/cleanup, recreate with the same verified email, and request Checkout.
expected: The retained versioned HMAC trial claim prevents a second trial without retaining the raw email.

cases.title: Concurrent same-email trial claims
actions: In the isolated SQL concurrency harness, race two disposable account UUIDs against the same synthetic HMAC fingerprint; do not attempt to create duplicate Supabase Auth emails.
expected: At most one claim is reserved or consumed and no raw email/fingerprint leaves the private ledger.

cases.title: Developer grant role and assurance denials
actions: Attempt a grant as ordinary user, technician, AAL1 global admin, and AAL2 global admin.
expected: Only AAL2 global admin can grant; every denial and success is bounded and auditable.

cases.title: Renewable subscription blocks developer grant
actions: Try a developer grant while a subscription can renew, then schedule period-end cancellation and retry.
expected: Renewable state blocks the grant; only a safely nonrenewing disposition allows it.

cases.title: Developer revoke never resumes billing
actions: Revoke a developer grant from an account with no renewable subscription.
expected: Access falls to the correct nondeveloper state and no Checkout, subscription, invoice, or charge is created.

cases.title: Directory and exact public link across entitlement states
actions: Compare a paid, suspended, developer, and unrelated viewer session in directory search and through an exact reviewed public URL.
expected: Suspension removes directory/search access and effective publication as specified; no private draft or owner identifier leaks through exact links or caches.

cases.title: Persona and business publication gating
actions: Observe reviewed persona and business pages before suspension, during suspension, after recovery, and after an edit that makes review stale.
expected: Unchanged eligible review can return after recovery; changed, stale, moderated, or ineligible revisions remain private.

cases.title: Friend and follow boundaries
actions: Exercise public follow, friend request, configured know-you verification, acceptance, suspension, and recovery.
expected: RLS and configured verification remain intact; suspension does not expose private relationships or allow bypass mutations.

cases.title: Interactive AI and owner research gates
actions: Exercise fan chat, research brief, image generation, Agent Board, and scheduled generation in paid, suspended, and developer states.
expected: Suspended work stops before credentials/provider access; paid/developer work also requires an enabled bounded AI budget and exact approval where applicable.

cases.title: Mailbox and publication provider-write race
actions: Change entitlement immediately before Gmail, Meta, and native-provider reads/writes in the isolated fault-injection boundary.
expected: Each path rechecks and stops before provider/native mutation; uncertain AI budget remains conservative.

cases.title: No stale work burst after recovery
actions: Accumulate due scheduled AI, mailbox, Meta, and native jobs while suspended, then restore a paid entitlement.
expected: Due occurrences advance or terminalize for explicit review; recovery does not publish or spend a catch-up burst.

cases.title: Billing status, Checkout, and Portal on signed-in mobile
actions: Load status, start and cancel Checkout, return, recover, and open Portal on physical mobile browsers.
expected: No horizontal overflow or obscured control; touch targets and keyboard focus work; cancellation never grants access; recovery refreshes server state.

cases.title: Account switching and stale response isolation
actions: Throttle a request for owner-a, sign out, sign in as viewer-b, then release the old response; repeat with back/forward and reload.
expected: No owner-a billing, media, relationship, handle, private page, or cached response appears in viewer-b state.

cases.title: AAL2 enrollment, step-up, interruption, and recovery
actions: Exercise TOTP enrollment, an interrupted challenge, successful step-up, expired assurance, factor recovery, and trusted-session boundaries.
expected: Private data stays held when required, sensitive actions reject AAL1, recovery cannot bypass identity proof, and assurance never crosses accounts.

cases.title: Keyboard, screen-reader labels, and reduced-width billing controls
actions: Complete status, Checkout start, Portal start, admin lookup, and hold reconciliation using keyboard/screen-reader navigation and 200 percent zoom.
expected: Focus order, labels, live errors, 44px touch controls, and zoom remain usable without hidden actions or identifier exposure.

cases.title: Private persona, business, family, project, and account inventory isolation
actions: Owner-a creates distinct private canary values in every listed surface; viewer-b tries UI routes, copied exact URLs, reload, history, and direct REST reads.
expected: Viewer-b receives no canary value, row, count, existence oracle, connected handle, or owner UUID.

cases.title: Opaque media and private preview isolation
actions: Copy public and owner-preview asset URLs, inspect DOM/network/cache, switch accounts, revoke/archive, and retry from viewer-b and anonymous sessions.
expected: Public delivery exposes no stable owner UUID; owner preview never survives account switch, revocation, archive, cache, history, or copied URL use.

cases.title: Authenticated account links and social handles
actions: Owner-a saves private authenticated-connection canaries and public handles; viewer-b inspects editor, settings, public page, REST, and exports.
expected: Only intentionally public handles render publicly; tokens, connection metadata, private handles, sync filters, and owner identifiers stay owner-scoped.

cases.title: Logout, cache, service worker, and shared-device cleanup
actions: Prime owner-a pages and previews, log out, use back/forward/offline/reload, then sign in as viewer-b on the same browser profile.
expected: Private HTML, JSON, images, names, counts, and billing state are unavailable after logout and never rehydrate for viewer-b.

cases.title: Full-screen asset preview and local-save authorization
actions: Open and save owner-a assets as owner-a, then try the same exact preview/save routes as viewer-b and after revocation.
expected: Owner-a can preview/save authorized originals; viewer-b cannot obtain private bytes or a durable owner-correlating URL.
evidence: download metadata without local path or identifiers

cases.title: Never-billed account full deletion
actions: Delete an approved disposable account that never bound a Stripe Customer.
expected: Private content and abandoned billing rows are erased; only the UUID closure tombstone and approved audit evidence remain.

cases.title: Billed Customer deletion and retention workflow
actions: Cancel and settle an approved disposable test subscriber, request deletion, run provider cleanup, then run application finalization.
expected: Renewal is impossible; Stripe Customer cleanup follows approved retention rules; financial evidence is minimized; Auth deletion occurs only after durable cleanup or a critical alert.

cases.title: Log and alert redaction
actions: Exercise success and failure paths, then inspect browser, Edge Function, database, Stripe delivery, WAF, and alert output.
expected: No secret, bearer token, raw webhook payload, raw email, email fingerprint, card data, provider identifier, owner UUID path, or private content appears in logs/alerts.

cases.title: Daily reconciliation and drift alert
actions: Run the read-only reconcile endpoint for a matching snapshot, then an isolated drift and provider-unavailable fixture.
expected: Current, drifted, and unavailable results are bounded; drift/unavailability alert; the probe never mutates money or entitlement.

cases.title: Backup restore and key-recovery drill
actions: Restore the staging billing schemas and secrets into an isolated recovery project using approved escrow, then run read-only parity checks.
expected: No secret enters evidence; trial claims, tombstones, audits, holds, and subscription snapshots preserve their approved semantics.

cases.title: Versioned trial-fingerprint key rotation
actions: Rotate twice to new staging HMAC key versions, retain every still-live older key in the ordered secret ring, test oldest-email replay, add a new claim, and verify approved retention cleanup before removing any retired key.
expected: Current, previous, and retired-generation claims remain replay-resistant; only the active key writes; no raw email or key material is stored or logged.
